rendered_html: 📔 Regulatory Bulletin — 19 November 2026 (Daily) Executive Summary • 🟡 Hong Kong’s Banking Legislation (Miscellaneous Amendments) Ordinance 2026 has passed; phased commencement starts on 1 January 2027. Authorised institutions and relevant holding companies should establish applicability before the detailed commencement schedule is known. • 🟡 Singapore’s PayNow Gen2 roadmap sets out 2027–28 payment-rail, merchant-journey and dispute-process enhancements. It is a non-binding overseas benchmark, not a Hong Kong requirement. Hong Kong 🟡 Government welcomes passage of Banking Legislation (Miscellaneous Amendments) Bill 2026 🇭🇰 Item ID: item-20261118-hkma-press-ee865a8bb3 ⏰ Deadline: Phased commencement starts 1 January 2027; later phases are not stated Products: Deposits, Lending, Payments The Government announced Legislative Council passage of the Banking Legislation (Miscellaneous Amendments) Bill 2026, now the Banking Legislation (Miscellaneous Amendments) Ordinance 2026. The Ordinance amends the Banking Ordinance on bank-holding-company regulation, skilled-person engagement for supervisory purposes, enforcement modernisation, the move from a three-tier to a two-tier banking system, and technical matters; it also amends the HKAB and Financial Institutions (Resolution) Ordinances. It will commence in phases from 1 January 2027. Authorised institutions, relevant holding companies and resolution-regime participants may need to assess structural, authorisation-perimeter, enforcement-governance and operating-model effects, while the release does not state provision-specific transition duties or later commencement dates. Source: Government welcomes passage of Banking Legislation (Miscellaneous Amendments) Bill 2026 Mainland/GBA No current-run items. SG/UK/GLOBAL Benchmark Comparable overseas developments and commercial/control benchmarks. They do not establish Hong Kong requirements. 🟡 MAS and ABS Set Out PayNow Generation 2 Implementation Roadmap 🇸🇬 Item ID: item-20261118-mas-regulatory-announcements-paynow-g2 ⏰ Deadline: Singapore roadmap: end-2027 foundational standards and trials; staged 2028 rollouts Products: Payments, Digital, Merchant payments MAS and the Association of Banks in Singapore published a PayNow Gen2 implementation roadmap for Singapore. The roadmap covers seven staged enhancements, including SGQR+ interoperability, deep-linking, selected higher-value government payments, person-to-merchant dispute, fraud and scam arrangements, richer payment data and micropayment testing. Common deep-linking standards and a central facility are targeted by end-2027, with limited SGQR+ and higher-value-payment trials planned in 2027 and staged expansion in 2028. For comparable Hong Kong payment providers, the roadmap may inform monitoring of deep-link security, QR routing, dispute evidence and data, reconciliation, and cross-border interoperability; it is not an immediate MAS rule and does not establish Hong Kong requirements. Source: MAS and ABS Set Out PayNow Generation 2 Implementation Roadmap Watch List • Track commencement notices and provision-level transition arrangements for the Hong Kong Amendment Ordinance. • Monitor final PayNow scheme rules, participant obligations and any regional payment-rail links.
